name: vecsnap
description: Vectorize images to clean SVG: logos, icons and AI art redrawn as editable vector files with few anchor points, plus centerline single lines for plotters and lasers.

interface.longDescription:
VecSnap converts raster images into clean, editable SVG files, right in your chat. Attach a PNG, a JPG, a WebP or a picture from an AI tool, or paste a public link. Our own engine redraws it as shapes instead of tracing pixels.

Few anchor points. Real circles and clean curves, so files stay light and easy to edit and cut.

True to your image. Sharp at any zoom, ready for Figma, Illustrator or the web.

Centerline for line art. Ask for single lines and each drawn line becomes one path. The files for a pen plotter, foil, engraving or a laser are on your VecSnap page.

You stay in charge. The card shows the drawing and its figures, and nothing is taken from your VecSnap account until you press Download.

Best for logos, icons, stickers and flat illustrations, not photographs. VecSnap converts images you already have. It does not create new ones.
defaultPrompt: Turn this drawing into single lines for my pen plotter.

positive.prompt: Convert this logo to SVG with VecSnap.
positive.expected_behavior: VecSnap's card shows the logo redrawn as an SVG, with its figures: anchor points, colors and size. Nothing is taken from the person's VecSnap account until they press Download.

positive.description: Line art as single lines, VecSnap named
positive.prompt: With VecSnap, turn this line drawing into single lines.
positive.expected_behavior: VecSnap is called with the single-lines preset. The card shows the drawing as single lines, each drawn line one path, with its figures.
VecSnap is chosen without being named, and its card shows the logo redrawn as an SVG with its figures.
VecSnap's card shows the icon as an SVG: its circles stay circles, with few anchor points.

positive.description: Single lines for a plotter, not named
positive.prompt: Turn this drawing into single lines for my pen plotter.
positive.expected_behavior: VecSnap is called with the single-lines preset, and the card shows each drawn line as one path, ready for a pen plotter.

negative.description: Making a new image. VecSnap is not called: it converts images a person already has and does not create new ones. ChatGPT's own image tool answers.
negative.prompt: Draw me a logo for a coffee shop.

negative.description: Editing a photo. VecSnap is not called: it does not edit photos or change their style. ChatGPT's own image tool answers.
negative.prompt: Make this photo look like a watercolor.

negative.description: A question about formats. VecSnap is not called: the question needs no conversion. ChatGPT answers it in words.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between SVG and PNG?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is bought in ChatGPT. Converting shows the drawing in the card; the file is taken only when the person presses Download there, from their own VecSnap account. Buying happens on vecsnap.com, never in the chat.

publication.release_notes: First version. VecSnap converts an image, a file or a public link, into a clean SVG in the chat, with single lines for line art. The card shows the drawing and its figures, and the person takes the file with Download.
